name: larger-feature
about: A bigger feature on the same stock project: CSV export and a validating import across a new module, the CLI and tests. Shows whether the team's fixed overhead shrinks against a larger plain-session cost.
goal: Add CSV support to the stock CLI. `python3 cli.py export OUT.csv` writes a header row `name,qty` and one row per item, alphabetical by name. `python3 cli.py import SRC.csv` adds each row's quantity to the stock (creating items that are new); with `--replace` the stock is first emptied so it ends up exactly as the file says. A row whose quantity is not a whole number or is negative, or that has no name, is invalid: the import then changes nothing, prints to stderr the line numbers of every invalid row (the header is line 1), and exits 1. Cover the new behaviour with tests.

criteria.text: WHEN export runs THEN the file has the header and one row per item, alphabetical
criteria.check: f=$(mktemp) && rm -f "$f" && c=$(mktemp) && rm -f "$c" && python3 cli.py --file "$f" add pear 2 && python3 cli.py --file "$f" add apple 5 && python3 cli.py --file "$f" export "$c" && test "$(tr -d '\r' < "$c" | tr '\n' ' ')" = "name,qty apple,5 pear,2 "

criteria.text: WHEN import runs THEN each row's quantity is added to the stock, creating new items
criteria.check:
f=$(mktemp) && rm -f "$f" && c=$(mktemp) && rm -f "$c" && printf 'name,qty
pear,2
fig,1
' > "$c" && python3 cli.py --file "$f" add pear 3 && python3 cli.py --file "$f" import "$c" && test "$(python3 cli.py --file "$f" total)" = "6"

criteria.text: WHEN import runs with --replace THEN the stock ends up exactly as the file says
criteria.check: f=$(mktemp) && rm -f "$f" && c=$(mktemp) && rm -f "$c" && printf 'name,qty\nfig,1\n' > "$c" && python3 cli.py --file "$f" add pear 3 && python3 cli.py --file "$f" import "$c" --replace && test "$(python3 cli.py --file "$f" total)" = "1"

criteria.text: WHEN a row is invalid THEN import changes nothing, names every bad line on stderr and exits 1
criteria.check:
f=$(mktemp) && rm -f "$f" && c=$(mktemp) && rm -f "$c" && printf 'name,qty
pear,x
fig,2
kiwi,-1
' > "$c" && python3 cli.py --file "$f" add pear 3 && before=$(cat "$f") && err=$(python3 cli.py --file "$f" import "$c" 2>&1 >/dev/null); rc=$?; test "$rc" = 1 && echo "$err" | grep -q 2 && echo "$err" | grep -q 4 && test "$before" = "$(cat "$f")"

criteria.text: WHEN the test suite runs THEN it passes
WHEN the feature is done THEN tests cover import and export
